nodes.label: app.py (single-file API server)
nodes.rationale: All API routes are in a single file app.py; in production it serves the built frontend via StaticFiles; dual-import pattern supports both package and direct runs.

nodes.label: app.py dual-import pattern
nodes.rationale: from .database import ... / from database import ... works both as a package import and when run directly.

nodes.label: Manual schema migration (no migration tool)
nodes.rationale: Schema changes done manually via PRAGMA table_info + ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN; no migration tool; new model fields need a matching ALTER TABLE block.

nodes.label: FastAPI StaticFiles production mount
nodes.rationale: Serves built frontend in production mode; must stay after all /api/* routes.

nodes.label: PyInstaller desktop build
nodes.rationale: Desktop builds bundle frontend/dist as static data.

nodes.label: vite.config.ts dev port override
nodes.rationale: Overrides Vite dev server to port 3000 instead of default 5173.

nodes.label: Venda desktop management system
nodes.rationale: Secure cross-platform desktop management system for general retail stores; role-based dashboards for admins, managers and cashiers.

nodes.label: localStorage session auth (store_im_auth)
nodes.rationale: No JWT or server sessions; login returns {username, role, is_first_login} stored in localStorage; frontend gates routes and shows forced password-change modal on first login.

nodes.label: Frontend route permission rules
nodes.rationale: cashier: /sales /orders /settings; manager adds /inventory /analytics /users; admin same as manager.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge-graph tooling
nodes.rationale: Project has knowledge graph at graphify-out/; run graphify query/path/explain before codebase questions; graphify update keeps graph current (AST-only, no API cost).

nodes.label: run.sh launcher
nodes.rationale: Sets up venv, installs deps, starts both servers.

nodes.label: Venda Retail Inventory Management System
nodes.rationale: Single app (not a monorepo) for retail store inventory management; backend + desktop frontend.

nodes.label: Vite port 3000 vs banner 5173 gotcha
nodes.rationale: run.sh banner misleadingly prints localhost:5173 but the server actually binds to 3000; CORS allowlist includes 3000 and 8000 to match.

nodes.label: PyPI pysqlite3>=0.6.0
nodes.rationale: SQLite3 fallback for systems without built-in sqlite3.

nodes.label: sqlite_patch.py (sqlite3 to pysqlite3 fallback)
nodes.rationale: Provides a sqlite3 to pysqlite3 fallback for systems without built-in sqlite3.
